name: facebookresearch_dpr/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_dpr/dense_retriever.py.generate_question_vectors: generate dense embedding vectors for a list of questions using a biencoder question encoder and tensorizer
facebookresearch_dpr/dense_retriever.py.create_DenseRetriever: create a DenseRetriever instance with a question encoder, batch size, and tensorizer to encode questions into vectors
facebookresearch_dpr/dense_retriever.py.build_LocalFaissRetriever: build a LocalFaissRetriever that indexes encoded passage vectors and retrieves top matching passages via FAISS KNN search
facebookresearch_dpr/dense_retriever.py.build_DenseRPCRetriever: build a DenseRPCRetriever that connects to a remote FAISS index server for distributed dense retrieval and search
facebookresearch_dpr/dense_retriever.py.validate_retrieval_results: validate retrieved passage results against ground truth answers and calculate top-k hit accuracy statistics

facebookresearch_dpr/generate_dense_embe.run_dense_embeddings: run the DPR tool to generate dense embeddings for a large document base using a pretrained encoder
facebookresearch_dpr/generate_dense_embe.run_gen_ctx_vectors: run gen_ctx_vectors to batch encode context passages into dense vector embeddings using a biencoder model
facebookresearch_dpr/generate_dense_embe.run_main_entry: run the main entry point to load a checkpoint, shard passages, and save embeddings as pickle files
facebookresearch_dpr/generate_dense_embe.refactor_gen_ctx_vectors: refactor gen_ctx_vectors to remove the conditional if branch when handling extra info in results
facebookresearch_dpr/generate_dense_embe.review_main: review the main function to understand how sharded passage encoding and pickle serialization work

facebookresearch_dpr/train_dense_encoder.run_biencoder_training: run the DPR BiEncoder training pipeline using Hydra config to train a dense retrieval model
facebookresearch_dpr/train_dense_encoder.validate_nll_loss: validate a trained BiEncoder model using negative log likelihood loss on a dev dataset
facebookresearch_dpr/train_dense_encoder.validate_average_rank: validate a BiEncoder model by computing the average rank of gold passages across negative pools
facebookresearch_dpr/train_dense_encoder.save_checkpoint: save a BiEncoder training checkpoint including model state, optimizer, and scheduler to disk
facebookresearch_dpr/train_dense_encoder.calc_inbatch_negatives_loss: calculate the in-batch negatives schema loss with DDP support by gathering representations across nodes

facebookresearch_dpr/train_extractive_re.run_reader_training: run the extractive reader model training pipeline on retriever results with a Hydra config
facebookresearch_dpr/train_extractive_re.validate_reader_model: validate the trained reader model on dev files and compute exact match scores
facebookresearch_dpr/train_extractive_re.save_reader_predictions: save reader model prediction results to a JSON file with span predictions and scores
facebookresearch_dpr/train_extractive_re.get_best_prediction: get the best answer span predictions from start and end logits for reader samples
facebookresearch_dpr/train_extractive_re.calc_reader_loss: calculate the training loss for the reader model given a batch of input data
